source.book: Original kid paraphrases. Book 1 is Genesis 1-2. Book 2 is Genesis 6-9. Book 3 is Exodus 1:22 and 2:1-10. Not a copyrighted Bible translation.
source.copyrightNote: Short original Tigrinya lines and English glosses for young children. Do not paste a published translation.
source.shape: Creation uses a weekday refrain. Sunday is the first day. Friday is the sixth day, when the people are made. Saturday is the seventh-day rest. Tuesday, the third day, has two pages: land and sea, then grass and trees. Noah is one connected paraphrase of Genesis 6-9: evil on the earth, Noah righteous and obedient, the ark, the family, the animals two by two, the shut door and the rain, the water, the raven, the dove, then dry land, then the rainbow promise. Moses is one connected paraphrase of the basket story: Pharaoh's order, the mother keeping the baby, the papyrus basket in the reeds, the sister watching, the princess finding him, her pity, the sister bringing the mother as nurse, the nursing, the name Moses, and God keeping the baby safe.
source.orthographyNote: God's name is እግዚኣብሄር with ሄ, the spelling in ትመ15 (YouVersion Bible 2998). Noah is ኖህ. Evil is ክፋእ. Righteous is ፃድቕ, as in Genesis 6:9. The ark is መርከብ. God commanded ኣዘዞ. Shut is ዓፀዎ. They went out ወፁ. The raven is ኳዅ, sent ሰደዶ. The dove is ርግቢ, sent ሰደዳ, returned ተመለሰት, holding ቘፅሊ ኣውሊዕ. Dry land is ንቑጽ. The bow is ቀስቲ. The promise is ኪዳን, as in Genesis 9 ኪዳነይ. Rain keeps the pack word ዝናብ; ትመ15 writes ዝናም. Trees in Creation follow ኣእዋም. Grass keeps ሳዕሪ. Creation's good stays ጽቡቕ; ትመ15 writes ፅቡቕ. Moses keeps ሙሴ, the river ሩባ, the reeds ሰልሰላ, and the sister ሓፍቱ. Yosief's line pass spells Pharaoh ፈርኦን, the basket ሳጹን, and the nurse ሞግዚት. Pharaoh's order is ኣዘዘ. Kid lines use ኣ, never አ. She saw the basket is ረኣየቶ. The name line is ስለዝተረኽበ, ሴመቶ.
source.unlockNote: In the Beginning is the free taste. It opens before any School Path unit is finished. Noah's Ark is not free: it uses the ordinary band-1 progress gate (learned the 8th family), the same gate the Amharic band-1 library uses. Baby Moses uses the next band, band 2 (learned the 16th family). On the Tigrinya pack that family is nye, the last family of School Path chapter 2. It does not change the Creation unlock, the Noah unlock, the School Path unlocks, or the Amharic tracks.
source.artNote: God is not drawn. Each painting shows the thing that page names. Creation and Noah stay in highland light. Moses is the Nile: papyrus reeds, the river, and a mudbrick palace for Pharaoh and his daughter. People have deep brown skin and wear sand, linen, or sage. No bright red, no modern dress, no headscarf. The order stays gentle: no harm is shown.

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰንበት ብርሃን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet senbet brhan fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Sunday God made the light.
pages.pictureHint: Highland dawn, gold light breaking over dry ridges, no sun disk yet, no people

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰኑይ ሰማይ ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet senuy semay fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Monday God made the sky.
pages.pictureHint: A vast highland blue sky, a few high clouds, only a thin escarpment

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰሉስ ምድሪን ባሕሪን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet selus midrin bahrin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Tuesday God made the land and the sea.
pages.pictureHint: Ochre highland hills meeting a clear turquoise Red Sea, no people, no boats

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰሉስ ሳዕሪን ኣእዋምን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet selus sarin aawamin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Tuesday God made the grass and the trees.
pages.pictureHint: Short highland grass, a baobab and acacias, plants only

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ረቡዕ ጸሓይን ወርሒን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet rebu tsehayin werhin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Wednesday God made the sun and the moon.
pages.pictureHint: Highland sky with a large warm sun and a large silver moon

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሓሙስ ኣዕዋፍን ዓሳን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet hamus aawafin asan fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Thursday God made the birds and the fish.
pages.pictureHint: Horn birds in a highland sky and large friendly fish in clear sea water

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ዓርቢ ሰብኣይን ሰበይቲን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet arbi sebayin sebeytin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Friday God made a man and a woman.
pages.pictureHint: A man and a woman with deep brown skin, modest long cotton clothes, standing by a baobab

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ቀዳም ዓረፈ። ኩሉ ጽቡቕ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet qedam arefe. Kullu tsbuq.
pages.meaningEn: On Saturday God rested. Everything was good.
pages.pictureHint: Quiet highland evening, the same two people resting under a baobab, a goat lying down, sea still

question.meaningEn: What did God make on Friday?

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ሰብ ኣብ ምድሪ ክፋእ ከም ዝገብር ረኣየ።
pages.latin: Igziabher seb ab mdri kfa' kem zigebr re'aye.
pages.meaningEn: God saw that people were doing evil on the earth.
pages.pictureHint: A few adults with deep brown skin in sand and sage cloth, turned away from each other, unkind but not violent, no Noah, no God

pages.geez: ኖህ ግና ፃድቕ ሰብ ነበረ። ንእግዚኣብሄር ድማ ይስምዖ ነበረ።
pages.latin: Noh gna tsadq seb nebere. Ni-Igziabher dma yism'o nebere.
pages.meaningEn: But Noah was a righteous man. He obeyed God.
pages.pictureHint: Noah alone, deep brown skin, sand linen tunic, calm, looking toward an empty sky, no divine figure

pages.geez: ማይ ብዙሕ ስለ ዝመጽእ፡ እግዚኣብሄር ንኖህ ዓባይ መርከብ ክሰርሕ ኣዘዞ።
pages.latin: May bzux sle zimetsi', Igziabher ni-Noh abay merkeb kiserh azzezo.
pages.meaningEn: Because a lot of water was coming, God commanded Noah to build a big ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah beside timber and the frame of a big wooden ark, a soft cloud on the horizon, empty sky, no God

pages.geez: ኖህን ሰበይቱን ደቁን ነታ መርከብ ሰርሑ።
pages.latin: Nohn sebeytun dequn neta merkeb serhu.
pages.meaningEn: Noah, his wife, and his children built the ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah, his wife, and two children building a wooden ark, sand linen and sage clothes, braided hair, no red, no animals

pages.geez: ድሕሪኡ ኖህን ሰበይቱን ደቁን ናብታ መርከብ ኣተዉ።
pages.latin: Dhr'u Nohn sebeytun dequn nabta merkeb atewu.
pages.meaningEn: After that, Noah, his wife, and his children went into the ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah, his wife, and two children walking into the open door of the wooden ark, no animals

pages.geez: እንስሳታት ከኣ ክልተ ክልተ ምስኦም ኣተዉ።
pages.latin: Insisatat ke'a kilte kilte msom atewu.
pages.meaningEn: And the animals went in with them, two by two.
pages.pictureHint: Clear pairs of lions, giraffes, elephants, and birds walking into the ark, calm, family small in the doorway

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ናይታ መርከብ ማዕጾ ዓፀዎ። ሽዑ ዝናብ መጸ።
pages.latin: Igziabher nayta merkeb ma'tso 'ats'o. Shyu znab metse.
pages.meaningEn: God shut the door of the ark. Then the rain came.
pages.pictureHint: The ark door shut, gentle rain beginning, no hand, no face, no people in distress

pages.geez: ማይ ነታ ምድሪ ሸፈነ። እታ መርከብ ግና ኣብ ልዕሊኡ ሰላም ነበረት።
pages.latin: May neta mdri shefene. Ita merkeb gna ab l'liu selam neberet.
pages.meaningEn: Water covered the land. But the ark was safe on the water.
pages.pictureHint: Calm water over highland hills, the wooden ark floating safely, no storm, no people

pages.geez: ዝናብ ደው ምስ በለ፡ ኖህ ቅድም ንኳዅ ሰደዶ። ኳዅ ግና ኣይተመለሰን።
pages.latin: Znab dew ms bele, Noh qdm n-kwakh sededo. Kwakh gna aytemelesen.
pages.meaningEn: When the rain stopped, Noah first sent the raven. But the raven did not come back.
pages.pictureHint: Noah at the ark window watching a black raven fly away over calm water, no dove, no olive leaf, no rainbow

pages.geez: ድሕሪኡ ንርግቢ ሰደዳ። ርግቢ ቘፅሊ ኣውሊዕ ሒዛ ናብ ኖህ ተመለሰት።
pages.latin: Dhr'u n-rgbi sededa. Rgbi qotsli awli' hiza nab Noh temeleset.
pages.meaningEn: Then he sent the dove. The dove came back to Noah holding an olive leaf.
pages.pictureHint: Clear sky, Noah at the ark window, one dove arriving with a clear olive sprig, no rainbow

pages.geez: ኖህን ስድራቤቱን ናብ ንቑጽ ምድሪ ወፁ።
pages.latin: Nohn sdrabetun nab nquts mdri wetsu.
pages.meaningEn: Noah and his family went out onto dry land.
pages.pictureHint: Noah, his wife, and two children stepping onto dry ochre land from the ark, clear sky, no rainbow

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ቀስቲ ኣብ ሰማይ ኣንበረ። እዚ ኪዳን እዩ።
pages.latin: Igziabher qesti ab semay anbere. Izi kidan iyu.
pages.meaningEn: God set a rainbow in the sky. This is his promise.
pages.pictureHint: The same family on dry land, a soft rainbow across the sky, the ark on the shore, no divine figure

question.meaningEn: What did God set in the sky?

pages.geez: ፈርኦን ንህዝቡ ነቶም ንእሽቶ ኣወዳት ክጎድእዎም ኣዘዘ።
pages.latin: Fer'on n-hzbu netom n'ishto awedat kgod'wom azzeze.
pages.meaningEn: Pharaoh commanded his people to harm the little boys.
pages.pictureHint: Pharaoh in a mudbrick Egyptian hall with lotus columns, deep brown skin, sand linen, one hand raised in an order, two officials in sage and undyed linen looking down, worried, no children, no violence, no God

pages.geez: እታ ኣደ ግና ንህፃና ሰለስተ ወርሒ ኣብ ቤት ዓቒባቶ።
pages.latin: Ita ade gna n-htsana seleste werhi ab bet 'aqibato.
pages.meaningEn: But the mother kept her baby safe at home for three months.
pages.pictureHint: A mother with deep brown skin in undyed linen holding a tiny baby close inside a simple mudbrick room, a woven mat, warm quiet light, no basket, no river, no palace

pages.geez: ምሕብኡ ምስ ሰኣነት፡ ብሻምብቆ ሳጹን ሰርሐት።
pages.latin: Mhba'u ms se'anet, b-shambqo sagtsun serhet.
pages.meaningEn: When she could no longer hide him, she made a papyrus basket.
pages.pictureHint: The same mother weaving a small tight papyrus basket, cut papyrus stalks beside her, the baby wrapped nearby but not in the basket yet, earth linen, no river, no palace

pages.geez: ነቲ ህፃን ኣብቲ ሳጹን ኣእትያ፡ ኣብ ሰልሰላ ሩባ ኣንበረቶ።
pages.latin: Neti htsan abti sagtsun a'tiya, ab selsela ruba anbereto.
pages.meaningEn: She put the baby in the basket and set it among the reeds of the river.
pages.pictureHint: The mother kneeling at a calm Nile edge, setting a small papyrus basket with the baby among tall green papyrus reeds, deep brown skin, sand linen, no sister, no princess

pages.geez: ሓፍቱ ርሕቕ ኢላ ደው በለት። ነቲ ሳጹን ውን ትርኢ ነበረት።
pages.latin: Haftu rhq ila dew belet. Neti sagtsun wn tri neberet.
pages.meaningEn: His sister stood far away. She was watching the basket too.
pages.pictureHint: A young girl with deep brown skin and braided hair, sage linen, standing still at a distance among papyrus, watching a small basket in the reeds, no princess, no mother in the foreground

pages.geez: ጓል ፈርኦን ናብ ሩባ ወረደት። ነቲ ሳጹን ኣብ ሰልሰላ ረኣየቶ።
pages.latin: Gwal Fer'on nab ruba weredet. Neti sagtsun ab selsela re'ayeto.
pages.meaningEn: Pharaoh's daughter went down to the river. She saw the basket in the reeds.
pages.pictureHint: Pharaoh's daughter at the Nile among papyrus, sand linen sheath and a muted earth collar, braided hair with no headscarf, looking at a closed papyrus basket in the reeds, no crying baby visible, no sister

pages.geez: እቲ ህፃን ምስ በኸየ፡ ጓል ፈርኦን ራህርሀትሉ።
pages.latin: Iti htsan ms bekheye, gwal Fer'on raherhatlu.
pages.meaningEn: When the baby cried, Pharaoh's daughter felt pity for him.
pages.pictureHint: The papyrus basket open among reeds, a crying baby, Pharaoh's daughter leaning close with a tender worried face, sand linen, no sister, no mother

pages.geez: ሓፍቱ ሞግዚት ክረኽበልኪ በለታ።
pages.latin: Haftu mogzit krehkebelki belet.
pages.meaningEn: His sister told her, "I will find a nurse for you."
pages.pictureHint: The young sister speaking to Pharaoh's daughter beside the basket in the reeds, the sister's hand open in an offer, both in linen and sage, no mother yet

pages.geez: እታ ሞግዚት ናይቲ ህፃን ኣደ እያ። ሓፍቱ ናብ ጓል ፈርኦን ወሰደታ።
pages.latin: Ita mogzit nayti htsan ade iya. Haftu nab gwal Fer'on wesedetta.
pages.meaningEn: The nurse was the baby's mother. His sister took her to Pharaoh's daughter.
pages.pictureHint: The sister leading the mother toward the princess and the basket at the river, three people, deep brown skin, linen and sage, the mother clearly the one being brought

pages.geez: እታ ኣደ ነቲ ህፃን ኣጥበወቶ። እቲ ህፃን ድማ ዓብየ።
pages.latin: Ita ade neti htsan atbeweto. Iti htsan dma abye.
pages.meaningEn: The mother nursed the baby. And the baby grew.
pages.pictureHint: The mother nursing a content baby in a quiet shaded reed shelter, sand linen, peaceful, no palace crowd, no God

pages.geez: ጓል ፈርኦን ካብ ማይ ስለዝተረኽበ ሙሴ ኢላ ሴመቶ።
pages.latin: Gwal Fer'on kab may slezterekhbe Muse ila semeto.
pages.meaningEn: Because he was found in the water, Pharaoh's daughter named him Moses.
pages.pictureHint: Pharaoh's daughter holding a small healthy child at the river's edge, calm water and papyrus behind them, sand linen, a naming moment, no God, no text

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ነቲ ህፃን ሙሴ ሓለዎ። ሰላም ረኸበ።
pages.latin: Igziabher neti htsan Muse halewo. Selam rekhebe.
pages.meaningEn: God watched over baby Moses. He was safe.
pages.pictureHint: The baby safe and asleep in his mother's arms among quiet papyrus at dawn, soft empty sky, no person in the clouds, no hand, no face of God, warm and still

question.geez: እታ ኣደ ነቲ ህፃን ኣበይ ኣንበረቶ?
question.meaningEn: Where did the mother set the baby?
